faq.title: Every project starts with a question.
faq.description: Clear answers to the questions people often ask before ordering a wood and epoxy resin creation.

items.question: What is a wood and epoxy resin creation?
items.answer: It is a piece that combines solid wood with epoxy resin, often used to highlight the natural shape of the wood or create a contrast of colour and transparency.

items.question: Can a table be completely custom made?
items.answer: Yes. Dimensions, shape, wood species, resin colour and finish can be defined according to the project and the constraints of the space.

items.question: What wood can be used with epoxy resin?
items.answer: Different species can be suitable. The choice depends on wood stability, moisture content, appearance and the final use of the piece.

items.question: How much does a wood and resin table cost?
items.answer: Price depends greatly on dimensions, wood species, amount of resin, design complexity and finish. A quote request provides an estimate tailored to the project.

items.question: How long does it take to make a piece?
items.answer: Timing varies by project, material availability and curing and finishing stages. The schedule is confirmed before fabrication begins.
